# CloudTalk Company Overview

CloudTalk is an AI-powered business phone system and AI voice agent platform for small and mid-sized sales and support teams.

![](https://media.cloudtalk.io/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto,quality=85,width=894,fit=scale-down/2026/08/Blog-Hero-_test.png)

## What Is CloudTalk?

[CloudTalk](https://www.cloudtalk.io/blog/what-is-cloudtalk/) is an AI-powered business phone system and AI Voice Agent platform built for sales and support teams. It brings business calling, AI-powered call intelligence, and autonomous AI voice agents together in one platform, helping small and mid-sized businesses make more calls, handle more conversations, and deliver better customer experiences.

Founded in Bratislava in 2016, CloudTalk has evolved into a global AI-powered calling platform used by 5,500+ businesses across more than 100 countries.

[Try for Free](https://www.cloudtalk.io/signup/)

[Contact Sales](https://www.cloudtalk.io/demo/)

## How CloudTalk Started

CloudTalk was founded in 2016 by Martin Malych and Viktor Vanek in Bratislava, Slovakia. The company started with a simple idea: make it easier for businesses to connect with their customers over the phone.

The initial product was an embeddable [click-to-call](https://www.cloudtalk.io/click-to-call/) widget. From there, CloudTalk evolved into a cloud-based business phone system designed to help sales and support teams manage their calls without relying on traditional phone infrastructure.

As customer expectations and business communication changed, so did CloudTalk's phone system.

## From Click-to-Call to   AI Calling Platform

The platform expanded beyond basic business calling to include call routing, international phone numbers, CRM integrations, call recording, analytics, and productivity tools. AI then became an increasingly important part of the product, bringing capabilities such as [AI Voice Agents](https://www.cloudtalk.io/ai-voice-agents/), call scoring, sentiment analysis, topic extraction, and AI-powered workflows into the calling experience.

Today, CloudTalk is an AI-powered calling platform for modern sales and support teams. The company solves challenges for over 5,500 businesses across 100+ countries. Our team consists of more than 200 talented members from across the globe, working both on-site and remotely.

## Who Uses CloudTalk

Different industries, different teams across the world, one business phone.

1. 01


**Size.** Small and mid-sized businesses. The sweet spot is a team of 10 to 200 people where calling is how revenue arrives or how customers get helped.

2. 02


**Teams.** Sales and outbound, customer support, IT and operations, recruiting, and companies that just need everyone on one phone system.

3. 03


**Industries.** Healthcare, real estate, recruitment and staffing, insurance, financial services, e-commerce and retail, education and e-learning, legal and professional services, travel and hospitality.

4. 04


**Locations.** Customers in 100+ countries. Local, national, mobile and toll-free numbers in 160+ countries.

## Frequently Asked Questions About CloudTalk

### What is CloudTalk?

CloudTalk is an AI-powered business phone system and AI voice agent platform built for [small](https://www.cloudtalk.io/the-cloud-phone-system-for-small-but-ambitious-businesses/) and [mid-sized](https://www.cloudtalk.io/the-cloud-phone-system-for-thriving-mid-market-businesses/) sales and support teams. It gives you local phone numbers in [160+ countries](https://www.cloudtalk.io/international-numbers/), cloud calling from a browser, desktop, or mobile, call routing and dialers, Conversation Intelligence, and AI voice agents that can answer or place calls on their own.

### What is CloudTalk used for?

Three main jobs. Running the whole company's phone system operation in the cloud instead of on-premise hardware. Understanding what happens on calls with [Reporting](https://www.cloudtalk.io/agent-reporting/), [Analytics](https://www.cloudtalk.io/analytics/) and Conversation Intelligence. And handling calls with [AI voice agents](https://www.cloudtalk.io/ai-voice-agents/) for 24/7 inbound and outbound.

### Who is the CEO of CloudTalk?

Martin Malych. He co-founded CloudTalk in 2016 with Viktor Vanek and has been CEO since.

### Who owns CloudTalk?

CloudTalk is a privately held company. It is owned by its founders, Martin Malych and Viktor Vanek, together with its employees and venture investors, including KPN Ventures and Lead Ventures, who co-led the 2024 Series B, plus Point Nine, henQ, Presto Ventures and Orbit Capital. CloudTalk has raised $36M to date and has not been acquired.

### Is CloudTalk free?

There is a 14-day free trial with no credit card required, and AI voice agents include 50 free minutes so you can test one before paying. After the trial, paid plans start at $25 per user per month billed annually.

### How much does CloudTalk cost?

[Business phone system plans](https://www.cloudtalk.io/pricing/) start at $25 per user per month on annual billing (Starter). Phone numbers start at $6 a month. AI voice agents are priced on usage: AI Receptionist starts free for the first 50 minutes, and AI Specialist starts at $349 a month for 1,000 minutes, dropping to about $0.15 a minute at high volume. Add-ons include AI Conversation Intelligence at $9 per user per month.

### What is the best CloudTalk alternative in 2026?

It depends on what you are replacing. Teams comparing CloudTalk usually look at Aircall, JustCall, Talkdesk, RingCentral, Dialpad and Five9. Compare the details on our [comparison pages](https://www.cloudtalk.io/comparison-overview/) before deciding.
